body.zh_CN:
酒桶用于酿酒与熟成，放置需要 3×3×3 空间。空手操作桶顶开盖；开盖后，对顶部中央加入四桶同种配方液体，再放原料。
各类原料尽量等量：开始酿造会消耗全部原料，产量取最少的一类。无额外原料的配方通常产出 16 瓶。开盖时空手点中央，可退回最后放入的一组原料。
空手点桶顶边缘关盖。出现品质 1 成品后便可取酒；成品未取空前，桶盖无法打开。留在桶里的酒会继续熟成，取走后品质不再提高。
酒嘴装在酒桶正面中央的孔口；在酒嘴正下方摆空酒瓶，开启酒嘴，约 1.5 秒后取回成酒。
通常每次升品质分别需要约 2、4、6、8、10 分钟，品质 1 到 6 合计约 30 分钟；各酒款以配方时间为准。熟成只在区块加载时推进。拆桶会失去剩余液体，搬走前先取空。
放下雪克杯，按鸡尾酒配方的三槽条件各投入一份材料，顺序不限。有品质等级的瓶装酒须达品质 4。
空手拿起雪克杯，对空按住使用摇酒，依提示在配方时机松手；其他时机可能调出特调或神秘鸡尾酒。
太早松手会取消，材料保留，可以重新摇酒。完成后，对摆好的空鸡尾酒杯使用雪克杯倒出成品，再空手取杯。
主手握杯，潜行并对空挥手会清空；材料与成品都会丢弃，不会退回。已有成品时，须先倒出或清空才能再调酒。
body.zh_TW:
酒桶用來釀酒與熟成，放置需要 3×3×3 空間。空手操作桶頂開蓋；開蓋後，對頂部中央加入四桶同種配方液體，再放原料。
各類原料盡量等量：開始釀造會消耗全部原料，產量取最少的一類。無額外原料的配方通常產出 16 瓶。開蓋時空手點中央，可退回最後放入的一組原料。
空手點桶頂邊緣關蓋。出現品質 1 成品後便可取酒；成品未取空前，桶蓋無法打開。留在桶裡的酒會繼續熟成，取走後品質不再提高。
酒嘴裝在酒桶正面中央的孔口；在酒嘴正下方擺空酒瓶，開啟酒嘴，約 1.5 秒後取回成酒。
通常每次升品質分別需要約 2、4、6、8、10 分鐘，品質 1 到 6 合計約 30 分鐘；各酒款以配方時間為準。熟成只在區塊載入時推進。拆桶會失去剩餘液體，搬走前先取空。
放下雪克杯，按雞尾酒配方的三槽條件各投入一份材料，順序不限。有品質等級的瓶裝酒須達品質 4。
空手拿起雪克杯，對空按住使用搖酒，依提示在配方時機鬆手；其他時機可能調出特調或神秘雞尾酒。
太早鬆手會取消，材料保留，可以重新搖酒。完成後，對擺好的空雞尾酒杯使用雪克杯倒出成品，再空手取杯。
主手握杯，潛行並對空揮手會清空；材料與成品都會丟棄，不會退回。已有成品時，須先倒出或清空才能再調酒。
body.en_US:
A barrel brews and ages drinks. Leave a clear 3×3×3 space. Use the lid with an empty hand to open it; add four buckets of the recipe fluid, then ingredients, through the top center.
Keep ingredient stacks equal: brewing consumes every ingredient and yields the smallest stack count. Recipes without extra ingredients usually yield 16 bottles. While open, use the top center with an empty hand to recover the last ingredient stack.
Use the lid edge with an empty hand to close it. Once Quality 1 appears, the drink is ready to bottle. The lid stays locked until the batch is emptied. Drinks keep aging in the barrel; bottled drinks stop aging.
Fit a tap to the central hole on the barrel front. Place an empty bottle directly below the tap, open it, and collect the drink after about 1.5 seconds.
Typical aging stages take about 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 minutes: roughly 30 minutes from Quality 1 to 6. Check each recipe for its timing. Aging advances in loaded chunks only. Empty the barrel before moving it; dismantling loses any remaining fluid.
Place the shaker and add one ingredient for each of the recipe’s three conditions, in any order. Bottled drinks with quality stages must be Quality 4 or higher.
Pick up the shaker with an empty hand. Hold use while aiming into air, then release at the recipe prompt. Other timings can make a signature or mystery cocktail.
Releasing too early cancels the shake and keeps the ingredients for another try. Pour the finished mix into a placed empty glass, then collect the glass with an empty hand.
To empty it, hold the shaker in your main hand, sneak and swing into air. This discards both ingredients and the result without a refund. Pour or empty a finished mix before mixing again.

body.zh_CN:
先在森林、平原或草甸的树叶下寻找野生葡萄藤，破坏取得藤蔓。三个葡萄藤直排可合成八个藤架，记得另留藤蔓种植。
种下时，藤架紧贴下方的方块决定品种：泥土类为普通葡萄，冰雪类为冰葡萄，下界岩或岩浆块为金葡萄。种下后移走这个方块，为果实留空。
藤蔓先向相邻裸藤架延伸，无处延伸时才向下结果；骨粉可催长。用蜜脾给裸藤架上蜡可阻止延伸，用斧头除蜡。
成熟果实用剪刀采收可得三个主果，也有机会得到青提。剪葡萄藤则会移除藤蔓和果实、退回藤蔓，留下裸藤架。
把同种配方水果放入压榨桶，在桶上跳跃压榨。每份压出 125 mB，八份凑满一桶后，用空桶收集果汁。
空手可逐个退回水果，潜行空手可一次退回整组。满桶后停止耗料；错误原料会在压榨时弹出。
拆桶会退回桶和水果，剩余果汁不会保留。
酒桶用于酿酒与熟成，放置需要 3×3×3 空间。空手操作桶顶开盖；开盖后，对顶部中央加入四桶同种配方液体，再放原料。

空手点桶顶边缘关盖。出现品质 1 成品后便可取酒；成品未取空前，桶盖无法打开。留在桶里的酒会继续熟成，取走后品质不再提高。
酒嘴装在酒桶正面中央的孔口；在酒嘴正下方摆空酒瓶，开启酒嘴，约 1.5 秒后取回成酒。
通常每次升品质分别需要约 2、4、6、8、10 分钟，品质 1 到 6 合计约 30 分钟；各酒款以配方时间为准。熟成只在区块加载时推进。拆桶会失去剩余液体，搬走前先取空。
酒嘴用于接取酒桶成品。装在酒桶正面中央的孔口，在正下方摆放配方要求的空容器。品质 1 就能装瓶。
操作酒嘴开启，约 1.5 秒后取回成品；再次操作可中止接取，红石信号由无变有也能开启。每次开启接取一份。
也可装在西瓜、装有液体的炼药锅等来源旁，接取内容取决于来源与下方容器。

body.en_US:
Find wild grapevines beneath leaves in forests, plains or meadows, and break them to obtain vines. Three vines in a vertical line craft eight trellises; keep another vine for planting.
The block directly beneath the trellis chooses the variety when planted: dirt-type blocks for regular grapes, ice or snow for ice grapes, netherrack or magma for gold grapes. Remove that block after planting to leave space for fruit.
Vines spread onto neighboring bare trellises before fruiting downward. Bone meal speeds growth. Wax a bare trellis with honeycomb to stop spreading onto it; use an axe to remove the wax.
Shear ripe fruit for three grapes and a chance of bonus green grapes. Shearing the vine instead removes it and its fruit, returns the vine, and leaves the bare trellis.
Add a stack of one recipe fruit and jump on the pressing tub. Each fruit produces 125 mB; eight fruits fill a bucket. Use an empty bucket to collect the juice.
Use an empty hand to take back one fruit, or sneak-use to recover the stack. A full tub stops consuming fruit; unsuitable ingredients are ejected when pressed.
Breaking the tub returns it and its fruit, but loses any remaining juice.
A barrel brews and ages drinks. Leave a clear 3×3×3 space. Use the lid with an empty hand to open it; add four buckets of the recipe fluid, then ingredients, through the top center.
Keep ingredient stacks equal: brewing consumes every ingredient and yields the smallest stack count. Recipes without extra ingredients usually yield 16 bottles. While open, use the top center with an empty hand to recover the last ingredient stack.
Use the lid edge with an empty hand to close it. Once Quality 1 appears, the drink is ready to bottle. The lid stays locked until the batch is emptied. Drinks keep aging in the barrel; bottled drinks stop aging.
Fit a tap to the central hole on the barrel front. Place an empty bottle directly below the tap, open it, and collect the drink after about 1.5 seconds.
Typical aging stages take about 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 minutes: roughly 30 minutes from Quality 1 to 6. Check each recipe for its timing. Aging advances in loaded chunks only. Empty the barrel before moving it; dismantling loses any remaining fluid.
A tap bottles barrel products. Fit it to the central hole on the barrel front and place the recipe’s empty container directly below. Quality 1 is already ready to bottle.
Use the tap to open it and collect one product after about 1.5 seconds. Use it again to cancel; a rising redstone signal can also open it. Each opening dispenses one product.
It also works beside sources such as melons and filled cauldrons. The source and container below determine what you collect.

單瓶架只收一瓶適合架型的酒、空酒瓶、燃燒瓶或西瓜汁；部分瓶型無法放入。手持瓶子點架子存放，空手取回，品質保留。

空手點高腳凳坐下，潛行離座。每張凳子供一人乘坐；搬走前先離座，破壞可回收。
body.en_US:
This holder stores one compatible drink, empty bottle, Molotov or watermelon juice; some bottle shapes do not fit. Use a bottle to insert it, or an empty hand to retrieve it with its quality intact.
A rising redstone signal launches the stored product; empty bottles are not launched. Breaking returns the holder and its bottle.
Use the stool with an empty hand to sit; sneak to stand. Each stool seats one person. Stand before moving it, then break it to recover it.

Vines spread onto neighboring bare trellises before fruiting downward. Bone meal speeds growth. Wax a bare trellis with honeycomb to stop spreading onto it; use an axe to remove the wax.
Shear ripe fruit for three grapes and a chance of bonus green grapes. Shearing the vine instead removes it and its fruit, returns the vine, and leaves the bare trellis.

body.zh_CN:
空酒瓶摆在酒嘴正下方，用于接取酒桶成品或其他来源的液体；开启酒嘴后等候装满，空手取回。
装满的酒瓶普通使用会饮用，潜行使用可摆放；对同种摆放的酒使用可叠放。空手逐瓶取回，品质各自保留。
body.zh_TW:
空酒瓶擺在酒嘴正下方，用來接取酒桶成品或其他來源的液體；開啟酒嘴後等候裝滿，空手取回。
裝滿的酒瓶普通使用會飲用，潛行使用可擺放；對同種擺放的酒使用可疊放。空手逐瓶取回，品質各自保留。
body.en_US:
Place an empty bottle directly beneath a tap to collect barrel drinks or liquids from other sources. Open the tap, wait for it to fill, then collect it with an empty hand.
Normal use drinks a filled bottle; sneak-use places it. Use it on a display of the same drink to stack bottles. Collect them one at a time with an empty hand; each keeps its quality.

body.zh_CN:
酒桶用于酿酒与熟成，放置需要 3×3×3 空间。空手操作桶顶开盖；开盖后，对顶部中央加入四桶同种配方液体，再放原料。
各类原料尽量等量：开始酿造会消耗全部原料，产量取最少的一类。无额外原料的配方通常产出 16 瓶。开盖时空手点中央，可退回最后放入的一组原料。
空手点桶顶边缘关盖。出现品质 1 成品后便可取酒；成品未取空前，桶盖无法打开。留在桶里的酒会继续熟成，取走后品质不再提高。
酒嘴装在酒桶正面中央的孔口；在酒嘴正下方摆空酒瓶，开启酒嘴，约 1.5 秒后取回成酒。
通常每次升品质分别需要约 2、4、6、8、10 分钟，品质 1 到 6 合计约 30 分钟；各酒款以配方时间为准。熟成只在区块加载时推进。拆桶会失去剩余液体，搬走前先取空。
放下雪克杯，按鸡尾酒配方的三槽条件各投入一份材料，顺序不限。有品质等级的瓶装酒须达品质 4。
空手拿起雪克杯，对空按住使用摇酒，依提示在配方时机松手；其他时机可能调出特调或神秘鸡尾酒。
太早松手会取消，材料保留，可以重新摇酒。完成后，对摆好的空鸡尾酒杯使用雪克杯倒出成品，再空手取杯。
主手握杯，潜行并对空挥手会清空；材料与成品都会丢弃，不会退回。已有成品时，须先倒出或清空才能再调酒。
单瓶架只收一瓶适合架型的酒、空酒瓶、燃烧瓶或西瓜汁；部分瓶型无法放入。手持瓶子点架子存放，空手取回，品质保留。
红石信号由无变有时会发射存放的成品，空瓶不会发射。破坏会退回架子和瓶子。
body.zh_TW:
酒桶用來釀酒與熟成，放置需要 3×3×3 空間。空手操作桶頂開蓋；開蓋後，對頂部中央加入四桶同種配方液體，再放原料。
各類原料盡量等量：開始釀造會消耗全部原料，產量取最少的一類。無額外原料的配方通常產出 16 瓶。開蓋時空手點中央，可退回最後放入的一組原料。
空手點桶頂邊緣關蓋。出現品質 1 成品後便可取酒；成品未取空前，桶蓋無法打開。留在桶裡的酒會繼續熟成，取走後品質不再提高。
酒嘴裝在酒桶正面中央的孔口；在酒嘴正下方擺空酒瓶，開啟酒嘴，約 1.5 秒後取回成酒。
通常每次升品質分別需要約 2、4、6、8、10 分鐘，品質 1 到 6 合計約 30 分鐘；各酒款以配方時間為準。熟成只在區塊載入時推進。拆桶會失去剩餘液體，搬走前先取空。
放下雪克杯，按雞尾酒配方的三槽條件各投入一份材料，順序不限。有品質等級的瓶裝酒須達品質 4。
空手拿起雪克杯，對空按住使用搖酒，依提示在配方時機鬆手；其他時機可能調出特調或神秘雞尾酒。
太早鬆手會取消，材料保留，可以重新搖酒。完成後，對擺好的空雞尾酒杯使用雪克杯倒出成品，再空手取杯。
主手握杯，潛行並對空揮手會清空；材料與成品都會丟棄，不會退回。已有成品時，須先倒出或清空才能再調酒。
單瓶架只收一瓶適合架型的酒、空酒瓶、燃燒瓶或西瓜汁；部分瓶型無法放入。手持瓶子點架子存放，空手取回，品質保留。
紅石訊號由無變有時會發射存放的成品，空瓶不會發射。破壞會退回架子和瓶子。
body.en_US:
A barrel brews and ages drinks. Leave a clear 3×3×3 space. Use the lid with an empty hand to open it; add four buckets of the recipe fluid, then ingredients, through the top center.
Keep ingredient stacks equal: brewing consumes every ingredient and yields the smallest stack count. Recipes without extra ingredients usually yield 16 bottles. While open, use the top center with an empty hand to recover the last ingredient stack.
Use the lid edge with an empty hand to close it. Once Quality 1 appears, the drink is ready to bottle. The lid stays locked until the batch is emptied. Drinks keep aging in the barrel; bottled drinks stop aging.
Fit a tap to the central hole on the barrel front. Place an empty bottle directly below the tap, open it, and collect the drink after about 1.5 seconds.
Typical aging stages take about 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 minutes: roughly 30 minutes from Quality 1 to 6. Check each recipe for its timing. Aging advances in loaded chunks only. Empty the barrel before moving it; dismantling loses any remaining fluid.
Place the shaker and add one ingredient for each of the recipe’s three conditions, in any order. Bottled drinks with quality stages must be Quality 4 or higher.
Pick up the shaker with an empty hand. Hold use while aiming into air, then release at the recipe prompt. Other timings can make a signature or mystery cocktail.
Releasing too early cancels the shake and keeps the ingredients for another try. Pour the finished mix into a placed empty glass, then collect the glass with an empty hand.
To empty it, hold the shaker in your main hand, sneak and swing into air. This discards both ingredients and the result without a refund. Pour or empty a finished mix before mixing again.
This holder stores one compatible drink, empty bottle, Molotov or watermelon juice; some bottle shapes do not fit. Use a bottle to insert it, or an empty hand to retrieve it with its quality intact.
A rising redstone signal launches the stored product; empty bottles are not launched. Breaking returns the holder and its bottle.
